venues.name: D&C DC
venues.weather: Was a beautiful day to start but got pretty chilly fast
venues.notes_summary: **DC — Sunday 3/1.** Quiet start that gradually built; room never completely full but good walk-ins from ~8:30 to close, and a last-minute pop right before close beat the sales target. Solid teamwork. Kitchen: 11.45% of sales, mostly bikini sandwiches, bread and butter and cookies. MOD: Jamal.

venues.name: D&C EV
venues.notes_summary: **EV — Sunday 3/1.** Minimal volume but guests wanting social breathing room; tables 'holding court' (a hair colorist, wool-sweater tech guys). Lots of spec/back-catalog touches; creative gluten-free option for the tuna; made a new friend with an in at Elsewhere. A late large non-US party was confused about tipping while splitting bills; suggest autogratuity for larger parties. Back catalog of the night: Beach Goth impressed Florida tiki enthusiasts. 4 large parties, 0 investor cocktails; comps $53.30 (mostly popcorn). Top sellers: Martini, Jabalina, First Time Listener (tie). Door: colder, calmer, fun Sunday; seated in waves from 6pm, fuller room by 7, mostly full all evening, no waitlist; Thomas handled the floor while Kyler and Dante managed bar guests; two-hour policy rarely needed; the hair colorist stayed five hours on dirty martinis. No no-shows. Kitchen: good work on the first turn. (Report posted Monday 11:47am; form typed '3//2' but content is Sunday 3/1.)
